data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes adverse prior year development of GBP 0.7m (2016: GBP 1.1m adverse). Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 141.815m. During 2017 there was a gross prioryear strengthening (adverse movement) of GBP 1.221m (approximately 0.86% of opening gross reserves), resulting in a net adverse prior year development of GBP 0.720m. The movement is attributed to adverse claims development primarily in property and thirdparty liability lines, partly offset by favourable movement in other areas.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet (Statement of Financial Position). Prior year development gross figure taken from the Technical Provisions note (Change in prior year provisions: Gross (1,221) GBP 000). The per-line prior-year breakdown in the notes is presented net of reinsurance; lob_movements above are derived from that net table and converted to the requested sign convention (parentheses in the report denote adverse movement). Gross per-LOB prior-year movements are not provided explicitly per line, so LOB amounts are net-based and marked with reduced confidence. Claims development triangle (gross) was used as cross-check.
